Inaugural Address at Edinburgh

Can there be a more horrible object in existence than an eloquent man not speaking the truth?

—
Address

Thomas

Carlyle

Harvard Classics, Vol. 25, Part 4

Inaugural Address at Edinburgh University
 2nd April 1866
 On Being Installed As Rector of the University There

Thomas Carlyle

Later published under the title “On the Choice of Books,” this oration is a clear statement of Carlyle’s moral passions.
